Built golf-course analytics platform using multiple databases (InfluxDB, OrientDB, DynamoDB, MySQL); pain from managing disparate stores seeded SurrealDB idea.

Rust-based multi-model database (document, graph, time-series, relational). $6M seed Nov 2022 led by FirstMark; subsequent rounds totaling ~$26M+ from FirstMark, Georgian, Crew Capital, Alumni Ventures.

outcomes.currentStatus: Co-founder & CEO of SurrealDB, London-based Rust multi-model database company; well-funded venture-backed startup positioning for the AI-data infrastructure wave.

lessons.lesson: Build the tool you needed yourself — SurrealDB came directly from the pain of stitching together four databases for an earlier product.
